title: The Beginning
text: My journey into programming began at the start of 2022. Feeling unfulfilled by my previous career choices, I decided to explore the exciting, yet unfamiliar world of web development. Taking a leap of faith, I left my previous job and fully committed to learning this new field.

Though the beginning of this journey was challenging, it was also thrilling. I took several courses on HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Git through Udemy. With determination and a strong desire to gain hands-on experience, I secured an internship at Hudlajf by early summer of that same year.

title: Hudlajf
text: Being part of the Hudlajf team was an incredible experience, and under the mentorship of a senior developer, my coding skills significantly improved. During my time there, I had the opportunity to work with SASS and my first JavaScript framework, Vue. This experience deepened my understanding of concepts like code reusability, components, recursive components, and how to organize code and folder structures in applications.

In November 2022, after several months of successful collaboration, our partnership came to a close due to changes in the company's strategic direction. Over the following three months, I focused on finding my first full-time role as a Junior Web Developer while further honing my Vue and JavaScript skills.

title: Humanfrog
text: In early February 2023, a new opportunity arose, and I accepted the role of Junior Web Developer at Humanfrog. Starting my first developer job was both exciting and educational. While I initially expected to work with Vue, which I was familiar with, I ended up primarily working with Laravel Blades and PHP. Unsure at first how I felt about the shift, I was fortunate to have a great mentor, and with her guidance, I quickly adapted to these new technologies. Working on large-scale, real-world projects significantly enhanced my skills, and I learned how to effectively collaborate with designers and backend developers. Toward the end of 2023, we began incorporating Tailwind into new projects, a framework I grew to really enjoy.
However, as time went on, I realized that for various reasons, it was time for me to pursue new opportunities. I made the decision to resign in February 2024.

title: Present
text: After leaving Humanfrog, I took a brief break to recharge and refocus. Once I felt ready, I resumed learning through courses on Udemy and YouTube, while also reading extensively about new technologies. I returned to working with Vue and decided to rework my personal webpage, applying everything I had learned up to that point.
That brings me to today—continuously learning new technologies and actively seeking my next opportunity.
